name: native-arm-latest607-fresh-installer
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source:
        description: Exact qualified274 installer library; current fresh607 child is github.sha
        default: bd0cf1891083d011b70edab10501c317d3720b78
        required: true
        type: string
      fresh_source_revision:
        description: Exact current Root published fresh607 child; must equal github.sha
        required: true
        type: string
      mode:
        description: Fresh native original-four builder and required FDK pair
        required: true
        default: build
        type: choice
        options: [build]
      inputs_sha256:
        description: Exact pinned Source input lock
        type: string
        default: beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f
      recipes_sha256:
        description: Exact pinned four-package recipe lock
        type: string
        default: a5fb287b4dda2a90bf61d4fa8cbbc5d666dad8bb450a70544d00545b091f36e3
      integration_sha256:
        description: Leave empty; this FDK-only job does not run integration
        type: string
        default: ''
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: native-arm-latest607-fresh-installer
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  native:
    if: github.repository == 'Gabriel-Kahen/cachy-asahi' && github.event.repository.private == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 350
    env:
      SOURCE_COMMIT: a79c4ca92486854f9edb639cd970d2c90fda4b12
      INPUTS_SHA256: ${{ inputs.inputs_sha256 }}
      RECIPES_SHA256: ${{ inputs.recipes_sha256 }}
      RETRY_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      REQUESTED_INTEGRATION_SHA256: ${{ inputs.integration_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: a79c4ca92486854f9edb639cd970d2c90fda4b12
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout the current fresh607 source child
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: fresh607-code
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Authenticate current child before original library gates or native actors
        shell: bash
        env:
          LIBRARY_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.fresh_source_revision }}
          CURRENT_WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$LIBRARY_SOURCE" = bd0cf1891083d011b70edab10501c317d3720b78
          [[ "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE" = "$CURRENT_WORKFLOW_SHA"
          test "$(git -C fresh607-code rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE"
          test "$(sha256sum fresh607-code/source-manifest.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 89f28bd898d4491abe05f346b91d9567620d747b4a0c22fb64fe8b09878fc3cd
          python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/run.py --source-preflight
      - name: Checkout issued Root accepted Six853 DATA record
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: eea3f3022c9214deacc60c92dfca13704420756b
          path: fresh607-record
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Materialize pinned historical input DATA without acquisition or acceptance replay
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/stage_inputs.py --record "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-record" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/fresh607-input-data"
      - name: Checkout the separate expanded604 installer implementation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source }}
          path: expanded604-installer
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require original library source and accepted native604 inputs before native work
        id: installer_policy
        shell: bash
        env:
          IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          WORKFLOW_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(sha256sum expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/ci.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = e9db1d8d2abebe363db9e6ebfc11e7ff2cfb3de19cf053efa7606219058666a3
          test "$(sha256sum expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/source-manifest.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 5f4dbc150a5f8ca6a85843b783e7b5472251a4b0761e75e65f7d82b165a7b629
          python3 -B expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/gate.py \
            --implementation "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-installer" --source "$IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE" \
            --workflow-sha "$WORKFLOW_SOURCE" --preflight
      - name: Checkout the fixed old helper and setup3 baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: b6b17e5f6b322f160f7eeb22c8a01380a3c854cd
          path: expanded604-legacy
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout unchanged original seven-pair input root
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 7fee76d68e5fd75437d8b49aaaced8376d2215cd
          path: expanded604-seven
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout the Root-bound accepted eight-pair input root
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.eight_source }}
          path: expanded604-eight
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public management source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.management_source }}
          path: expanded604-management-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public setup source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.setup_source }}
          path: expanded604-setup-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public welcome source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.welcome_source }}
          path: expanded604-welcome-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public fresh600 decisions
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.fresh600_decisions }}
          path: expanded604-fresh600-decisions
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public native604 decisions
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.native604_decisions }}
          path: expanded604-native604-decisions
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact apps6_source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.apps6_source }}
          path: apps6-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact apps6_authority_source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.apps6_authority_source }}
          path: apps6-authority
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Retrieve only the six original pinned audio inputs
        id: audio_inputs
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B expanded604-legacy/scripts/ci/full-development-composition/retrieve_audio.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/audio-archives"
      - name: Verify actual Root decisions and accepted archive bytes before secrets
        shell: bash
        env:
          IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          WORKFLOW_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/gate.py \
            --implementation "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-installer" --source "$IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE" \
            --workflow-sha "$WORKFLOW_SOURCE" --legacy-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-legacy" \
            --seven-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-seven" --eight-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-eight" \
            --management-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-management-source/payload" \
            --setup-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-setup-source" \
            --welcome-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-welcome-source/payload" \
            --fresh600-decisions "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-fresh600-decisions" \
            --native604-decisions "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-native604-decisions" \
            --apps6-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/apps6-inputs/payload" --apps6-authority-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/apps6-authority" \
            --audio-inputs "$RUNNER_TEMP/audio-archives"
      - name: Run unchanged installer controls and focused604 controls without actors
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPANDED600_LEGACY_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-legacy
          EXPANDED600_SEVEN_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-seven
          CURRENT604_INSTALLER_SOURCE: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-installer
          PUBLIC_PAIR_INSTALLER_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-installer
          PUBLIC_PAIR_COMPOSITION_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-installer
          EXPANDED604_SOURCE: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-installer
          EXPANDED604_LEGACY_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-legacy
          EXPANDED604_FRESH600_DECISION: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-fresh600-decisions/payload/fresh600.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo -n -- python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-code/implementation/source_controls.py" --workspace "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
      - name: Seed the six frozen private cache objects before native work
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        shell: bash
        env:
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_01 }}
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_02 }}
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_SIGNATURE_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_SIGNATURE_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SCHEMA: '1'
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SOURCE_EPOCH: '1791748800'
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_02 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_SIG_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_SIG_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_02 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_03: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_03 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_04: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_04 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_05: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_05 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_06: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_06 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_07: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_07 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_08: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_08 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_09: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_09 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_10: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_10 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_11: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_11 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_12: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_12 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_13: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_13 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_14: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_14 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_15: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_15 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_SIG_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_SIG_01 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_COMMIT"
          test "$INPUTS_SHA256" = beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 75s python3 -B - <<'PYSEED'
          import hashlib
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import sys
          sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts/ci')
          from old_four_seed import (OLD_FOUR_PRIVATE_ROWS, RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_PRIVATE_ROWS,
                                     seed_current_build_cache)
          pin = 'beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f'
          if hashlib.sha256(Path('scripts/ci/inputs.lock.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest() != pin:
              raise SystemExit('private-cache-input-binding-refused')
          names = {'CACHY_OLD_FOUR_' + f'{tag}_{i:02d}'
                   for _, _, _, tag, count in OLD_FOUR_PRIVATE_ROWS for i in range(1, count + 1)}
          retained = {'CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_' + f'{tag}_{i:02d}'
                      for _, _, _, tag, sizes in RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_PRIVATE_ROWS
                      for i in range(1, len(sizes) + 1)}
          names |= retained
          if len(names) != 22 or len(retained) != 3 or not all(os.environ.get(name) for name in names):
              raise SystemExit('private-cache-required-secrets-missing')
          cache = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'alarm-cache'
          cache.mkdir(mode=0o700)
          keep = names | {'CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SCHEMA', 'CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SOURCE_EPOCH'}
          for name in tuple(os.environ):
              if name not in keep:
                  os.environ.pop(name)
          seed_current_build_cache(cache, pin)
          PYSEED
      - name: Checkout exact retained public input source
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # existing pinned checkout
        with:
          ref: 04a4a74e16e1e1bc939ea74791bf1f1bf7b46bbd
          path: retained-public-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Seed fourteen exact public ARM input files
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs" rev-parse HEAD)" = 04a4a74e16e1e1bc939ea74791bf1f1bf7b46bbd
          test "$(sha256sum retained-public-inputs/seed.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = a7857658af224984065e575f6ffed8308ea85027d46eace8bda146d9033e93b3
          test "$(sha256sum retained-public-inputs/index.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = a388c8c8ba8e06cb92fd2be598b86e433c4e403b6e71a0f15b1eaec381bb7300
          env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$HOME" LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC \
            TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP" \
            python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs/seed.py" \
              --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/alarm-cache"
      - name: Checkout exact complete574 retained package inputs
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ddc6ca5f3478f9c607f8fae52661c451ae0bf3ad
          path: retained-complete574
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Join all complete574 retained cache inputs before original acquisition
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        timeout-minutes: 5
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-complete574" rev-parse HEAD)" = ddc6ca5f3478f9c607f8fae52661c451ae0bf3ad
          test "$(sha256sum retained-complete574/seed.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 76b787fa71b121ec1bf83b86e4d5db849913614bc90e03239b869d7061af1db4
          test "$(sha256sum retained-complete574/index.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 51a53c9e0d9eab1728f350f9ab8d3d7b8932891ab0ed68c7876a1440166ff486
          test "$(sha256sum retained-complete574/desktop574-inputs.lock.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = b2a234c76c3a820382238023203a8b699a503153f63b938376fd16433c4d90f9
          test "$(sha256sum scripts/ci/native_arm.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = a8b6ed8971a38089a4499dcec605477c4e48d7a47c3de485d205f6a44678b898
          test "$(sha256sum scripts/ci/inputs.lock.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f
          deadline=$(env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin python3 -I -B -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic()+240)')
          env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$HOME" LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP" \
            python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-complete574/seed.py" \
              --lock "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-complete574/desktop574-inputs.lock.json" \
              --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/alarm-cache" --mode desktop574 --deadline "$deadline"
      - name: Build the fresh native base and original package pairs
        id: original_build
        timeout-minutes: 50
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$RETRY_MODE" = build
          test "$INPUTS_SHA256" = beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f
          test "$RECIPES_SHA256" = a5fb287b4dda2a90bf61d4fa8cbbc5d666dad8bb450a70544d00545b091f36e3
          test -z "$REQUESTED_INTEGRATION_SHA256"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_COMMIT"
          install -d -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop-docker-config"
          test "$(sha256sum retained-public-inputs/seed.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = a7857658af224984065e575f6ffed8308ea85027d46eace8bda146d9033e93b3
          test "$(sha256sum retained-public-inputs/index.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = a388c8c8ba8e06cb92fd2be598b86e433c4e403b6e71a0f15b1eaec381bb7300
          env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$HOME" LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC \
            RUNNER_TEMP="$RUNNER_TEMP" DOCKER_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop-docker-config" \
            GITHUB_SHA="$SOURCE_COMMIT" GITHUB_REPOSITORY="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            GITHUB_RUN_ID="$GITHUB_RUN_ID" GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT="$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
            PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 INPUTS_SHA256="$INPUTS_SHA256" RECIPES_SHA256="$RECIPES_SHA256" \
            /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail <<'RUN_ORIGINAL_BUILDS'
          export TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP"
          python3 -B scripts/ci/native_arm.py build \
            --inputs-sha256 "$INPUTS_SHA256" --recipes-sha256 "$RECIPES_SHA256" \
            --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/alarm-cache" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-evidence"
          RUN_ORIGINAL_BUILDS
      - name: Retain bounded original-four and base evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-evidence" ]; then
            python3 -B scripts/ci/log_evidence.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-evidence"
          fi
      - name: Checkout the fixed FDK source
        id: fdk_source
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.original_build.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 804b418f14459e82031046fb28a0308b4cb9348e
          path: fdk-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Required FDK pair on this job native base
        id: fdk_pair
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
        timeout-minutes: 25
        shell: bash
        env:
          FDK_CHECKOUT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.fdk_source.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$FDK_CHECKOUT_OUTCOME" = success
          install -d -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-docker-config"
          env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-home" LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC \
            RUNNER_TEMP="$RUNNER_TEMP" TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
            DOCKER_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-docker-config" \
            FDK_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fdk-source" \
            FDK_NATIVE_OUTPUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/native-evidence" \
            FDK_OUTPUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-evidence" \
            /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail > "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-driver.log" 2>&1 <<'RUN_FDK'
          # Optional post-core step. Uses only the original base builder on this daemon.
          set -euo pipefail
          source_root=${FDK_SOURCE_ROOT:?}
          native_out=${FDK_NATIVE_OUTPUT:?}
          out=${FDK_OUTPUT:?}
          mkdir -m 700 "$out"
          status=FAIL
          finish() {
              rc=$?
              printf 'FDK_PAIR=%s\nEXIT=%s\n' "$status" "$rc" > "$out/result.txt" || :
              cat "$out/result.txt" || :
              if [[ $status == FAIL ]]; then
                  for log in "$out"/build-*/build.log "$out"/*.log; do
                      [[ ! -f $log ]] || tail -n 40 "$log" || :
                  done
              fi
              return "$rc"
          }
          trap finish EXIT
          image=$(python3 - "$source_root" "$native_out" "$out" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import hashlib, json, re, sys
          source, native, out = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
          result = native / 'result.json'
          if not result.exists() or json.loads(result.read_text()).get('native_build') != 'PASS':
              raise SystemExit(0)
          bootstrap = json.loads((native / 'bootstrap.json').read_text())
          image = (native / 'image-id').read_text().strip()
          assert re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', image)
          assert bootstrap['status'] == 'image-provisioned' and bootstrap['image_id'] == image
          assert hashlib.sha256((native / 'packages.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == bootstrap['packages_lock_sha256']
          recipe = source / 'packages/libraries/cachy-asahi-fdk-aac/PKGBUILD'
          digest = hashlib.sha256(recipe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          assert digest == '774803633213d77e9879005608ff23528b6780465c7bd00f3234430c9a7346df'
          for name in ('template-inputs.json', 'reviewed-inputs.json'):

            /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail <<'RUN_ORIGINAL_BUILDS'
          export TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP"
          python3 -B scripts/ci/native_arm.py build \
            --inputs-sha256 "$INPUTS_SHA256" --recipes-sha256 "$RECIPES_SHA256" \
            --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/alarm-cache" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-evidence"
          RUN_ORIGINAL_BUILDS
      - name: Retain bounded original-four and base evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-evidence" ]; then
            python3 -B scripts/ci/log_evidence.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-evidence"
          fi
      - name: Checkout the fixed FDK source
        id: fdk_source
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.original_build.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 804b418f14459e82031046fb28a0308b4cb9348e
          path: fdk-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Required FDK pair on this job native base
        id: fdk_pair
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
        timeout-minutes: 25
        shell: bash
        env:
          FDK_CHECKOUT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.fdk_source.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$FDK_CHECKOUT_OUTCOME" = success
          install -d -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-docker-config"
          env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-home" LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC \
            RUNNER_TEMP="$RUNNER_TEMP" TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
            DOCKER_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-docker-config" \
            FDK_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fdk-source" \
            FDK_NATIVE_OUTPUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/native-evidence" \
            FDK_OUTPUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-evidence" \
            /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail > "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-driver.log" 2>&1 <<'RUN_FDK'
          # Optional post-core step. Uses only the original base builder on this daemon.
          set -euo pipefail
          source_root=${FDK_SOURCE_ROOT:?}
          native_out=${FDK_NATIVE_OUTPUT:?}
          out=${FDK_OUTPUT:?}
          mkdir -m 700 "$out"
          status=FAIL
          finish() {
              rc=$?
              printf 'FDK_PAIR=%s\nEXIT=%s\n' "$status" "$rc" > "$out/result.txt" || :
              cat "$out/result.txt" || :
              if [[ $status == FAIL ]]; then
                  for log in "$out"/build-*/build.log "$out"/*.log; do
                      [[ ! -f $log ]] || tail -n 40 "$log" || :
                  done
              fi
              return "$rc"
          }
          trap finish EXIT
          image=$(python3 - "$source_root" "$native_out" "$out" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import hashlib, json, re, sys
          source, native, out = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
          result = native / 'result.json'
          if not result.exists() or json.loads(result.read_text()).get('native_build') != 'PASS':
              raise SystemExit(0)
          bootstrap = json.loads((native / 'bootstrap.json').read_text())
          image = (native / 'image-id').read_text().strip()
          assert re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', image)
          assert bootstrap['status'] == 'image-provisioned' and bootstrap['image_id'] == image
          assert hashlib.sha256((native / 'packages.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == bootstrap['packages_lock_sha256']
          recipe = source / 'packages/libraries/cachy-asahi-fdk-aac/PKGBUILD'
          digest = hashlib.sha256(recipe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          assert digest == '774803633213d77e9879005608ff23528b6780465c7bd00f3234430c9a7346df'
          for name in ('template-inputs.json', 'reviewed-inputs.json'):
              data = json.loads((source / 'scripts/port/fdk-native-stage' / name).read_text())
              data['PKGBUILD'] = digest
              (out / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')
          print(image)
          PY
          )
          if [[ -z $image ]]; then
              status=SKIPPED
              printf 'No successful original-four builder; FDK was not run.\n'
              exit 0
          fi
          python3 -B "$source_root/packages/libraries/cachy-asahi-fdk-aac/select-source.py" \
              --fetch-upstream --output "$out/selected-source.tar" > "$out/selection.log" 2>&1
          template_sha=$(sha256sum "$out/template-inputs.json" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
          python3 -B "$source_root/packages/libraries/cachy-asahi-fdk-aac/materialize.py" \
              --archive "$out/selected-source.tar" --output "$out/recipe" \
              --reviewed-template "$out/template-inputs.json" \
              --reviewed-template-sha256 "$template_sha" > "$out/materialize.log" 2>&1
          for attempt in 1 2; do
              python3 -B "$source_root/scripts/build/build.py" "$out/recipe" \
                  --image "$image" --output "$out/build-$attempt" --mode native \
                  --source-date-epoch 1791748800 --network none --timeout 600 \
                  --expected-packages "$native_out/packages.lock" \
                  --reviewed-inputs "$out/reviewed-inputs.json" > "$out/build-$attempt.log" 2>&1
          done
          python3 -B "$source_root/scripts/build/compare.py" \
              "$out/build-1" "$out/build-2" --require-bytes > "$out/compare.json" 2> "$out/compare.log"
          cat "$out/compare.json"
          status=PASS
          RUN_FDK
          grep -qx 'FDK_PAIR=PASS' "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-evidence/result.txt"
      - name: Retain bounded FDK metadata and separate outcome
        if: always()

          FDK_CHECKOUT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.fdk_source.outcome }}

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

            printf '\n### FDK-only native job\nOriginal pairs: %s; FDK checkout: %s; FDK step: %s\n' \

          python3 -B - <<'PYFDKLOG'

          public.mkdir()

          names += [f'build-{i}/{name}' for i in (1, 2) for name in ('provenance.json', 'validation.json')]
          for name in names:
              original, target = source / name, public / name
              if original.is_file():
                  target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                  shutil.copyfile(original, target)
          for name, original in [('driver-tail.log', root / 'fdk-driver.log')] + [
                  (f'build-{i}-tail.log', source / f'build-{i}/build.log') for i in (1, 2)]:
              if original.is_file():

          (public / 'scope.txt').write_text('FDK build-pair metadata only; lifecycle/integration NOT RUN; no package binaries uploaded.\n')
          PYFDKLOG
          python3 -B scripts/ci/log_evidence.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-metadata"
      - name: Checkout the ten current development recipes
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.fdk_pair.outcome == 'success' }}

        with:
          ref: a58fca33c4db5f2ab3ea6111f4d7842a932cc336
          path: composition-product

      - name: Checkout the exact updater compiler implementation
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.fdk_pair.outcome == 'success' }}

          ref: 1aea667aec50a62ba0ab2dad44be24a4dc3bd098

      - name: Checkout exact retained compiler6 archive and signature inputs
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.fdk_pair.outcome == 'success' }}

        with:
          ref: 8ee14069b7a74455a7bea1171ba319932c9df304
          path: retained-compiler6
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Join six original354 compiler inputs into the same private cache
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.fdk_pair.outcome == 'success' }}
        timeout-minutes: 5
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-compiler6" rev-parse HEAD)" = 8ee14069b7a74455a7bea1171ba319932c9df304
          test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/composition-updater" rev-parse HEAD)" = 1aea667aec50a62ba0ab2dad44be24a4dc3bd098
          deadline=$(env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin python3 -I -B -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic()+240)')

      - name: Checkout the proven 574-package runtime builder

        with:
          ref: 9a2e520dbdfce7e4af417595ff3de9e6a284ef04
          path: composition-desktop

      - name: Checkout the exact v2 updater implementation

      - name: Checkout exact retained original35 tooling inputs
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.fdk_pair.outcome == 'success' }}
        timeout-minutes: 5
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: fb515d735a81194f06ea117539dee60438bb8d87

          set -euo pipefail

          import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,stat
          source=pathlib.Path('/tmp')/('cachy-asahi-expanded604-installer-'+os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']+'-'+os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'])
          target=pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'expanded604-installer-public'

              (target/name).write_bytes(raw)

          (target/'retention.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(files=rows,raw_bytes=total,

before_bodies..github/workflows/native-arm-build.yml:
name: native-arm-latest607-fresh-installer
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source:
        description: Exact qualified274 installer library; current fresh607 child is github.sha
        default: bd0cf1891083d011b70edab10501c317d3720b78
        required: true
        type: string
      fresh_source_revision:
        description: Exact current Root published fresh607 child; must equal github.sha
        required: true
        type: string
      page_mode:
        description: Generic software VM page mode;16K uses only fixed BUILD_ONLY kernel20
        required: true
        default: generic4k
        type: choice
        options: [generic4k, generic16k]
      mode:
        description: Fresh native original-four builder and required FDK pair
        required: true
        default: build
        type: choice
        options: [build]
      inputs_sha256:
        description: Exact pinned Source input lock
        type: string
        default: beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f
      recipes_sha256:
        description: Exact pinned four-package recipe lock
        type: string
        default: a5fb287b4dda2a90bf61d4fa8cbbc5d666dad8bb450a70544d00545b091f36e3
      integration_sha256:
        description: Leave empty; this FDK-only job does not run integration
        type: string
        default: ''
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: native-arm-latest607-fresh-installer
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  native:
    if: github.repository == 'Gabriel-Kahen/cachy-asahi' && github.event.repository.private == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 350
    env:
      SOURCE_COMMIT: a79c4ca92486854f9edb639cd970d2c90fda4b12
      INPUTS_SHA256: ${{ inputs.inputs_sha256 }}
      RECIPES_SHA256: ${{ inputs.recipes_sha256 }}
      RETRY_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      REQUESTED_INTEGRATION_SHA256: ${{ inputs.integration_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: a79c4ca92486854f9edb639cd970d2c90fda4b12
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout the current fresh607 source child
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: fresh607-code
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Authenticate current child before original library gates or native actors
        shell: bash
        env:
          LIBRARY_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.fresh_source_revision }}
          CURRENT_WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$LIBRARY_SOURCE" = bd0cf1891083d011b70edab10501c317d3720b78
          [[ "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE" = "$CURRENT_WORKFLOW_SHA"
          test "$(git -C fresh607-code rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE"
          test "$(sha256sum fresh607-code/source-manifest.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 2439d4eb26c88f322da0224784d7fa1d490fce959f007385505f6eed992714a5
          python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/run.py --source-preflight
      - name: Checkout exact kernel20 build-only source context for explicit16K
        if: ${{ inputs.page_mode == 'generic16k' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: de1aab259df6bda8ad36f959392e3fc4eb35b622
          path: fresh607-kernel20-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Acquire only exact existing BUILD_ONLY kernel20 input for explicit16K
        if: ${{ inputs.page_mode == 'generic16k' }}

        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 300s python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/kernel20_input.py --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-kernel20-source" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/fresh607-kernel20-data"
      - name: Checkout issued Root accepted Six853 DATA record
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: eea3f3022c9214deacc60c92dfca13704420756b
          path: fresh607-record
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Materialize pinned historical input DATA without acquisition or acceptance replay
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/stage_inputs.py --record "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-record" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/fresh607-input-data"
      - name: Checkout the separate expanded604 installer implementation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source }}
          path: expanded604-installer
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require original library source and accepted native604 inputs before native work
        id: installer_policy
        shell: bash
        env:
          IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          WORKFLOW_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(sha256sum expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/ci.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = e9db1d8d2abebe363db9e6ebfc11e7ff2cfb3de19cf053efa7606219058666a3
          test "$(sha256sum expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/source-manifest.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 5f4dbc150a5f8ca6a85843b783e7b5472251a4b0761e75e65f7d82b165a7b629
          python3 -B expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/gate.py \
            --implementation "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-installer" --source "$IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE" \
            --workflow-sha "$WORKFLOW_SOURCE" --preflight
      - name: Checkout the fixed old helper and setup3 baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: b6b17e5f6b322f160f7eeb22c8a01380a3c854cd
          path: expanded604-legacy
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout unchanged original seven-pair input root
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 7fee76d68e5fd75437d8b49aaaced8376d2215cd
          path: expanded604-seven
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout the Root-bound accepted eight-pair input root

      ".github/workflows/native-arm-build.yml": "name: native-arm-latest607-fresh-installer
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source:
        description: Exact qualified274 installer library; current fresh607 child is github.sha
        default: bd0cf1891083d011b70edab10501c317d3720b78
        required: true
        type: string
      fresh_source_revision:
        description: Exact current Root published fresh607 child; must equal github.sha
        required: true
        type: string
      page_mode:
        description: Generic software VM page mode;16K uses only fixed BUILD_ONLY kernel20
        required: true
        default: generic4k
        type: choice
        options: [generic4k, generic16k]
      mode:
        description: Fresh native original-four builder and required FDK pair
        required: true
        default: build
        type: choice
        options: [build]
      inputs_sha256:
        description: Exact pinned Source input lock
        type: string
        default: beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f
      recipes_sha256:
        description: Exact pinned four-package recipe lock
        type: string
        default: a5fb287b4dda2a90bf61d4fa8cbbc5d666dad8bb450a70544d00545b091f36e3
      integration_sha256:
        description: Leave empty; this FDK-only job does not run integration
        type: string
        default: ''
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: native-arm-latest607-fresh-installer
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  native:
    if: github.repository == 'Gabriel-Kahen/cachy-asahi' && github.event.repository.private == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 350
    env:
      SOURCE_COMMIT: a79c4ca92486854f9edb639cd970d2c90fda4b12
      INPUTS_SHA256: ${{ inputs.inputs_sha256 }}
      RECIPES_SHA256: ${{ inputs.recipes_sha256 }}
      RETRY_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      REQUESTED_INTEGRATION_SHA256: ${{ inputs.integration_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: a79c4ca92486854f9edb639cd970d2c90fda4b12
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout the current fresh607 source child
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: fresh607-code
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Authenticate current child before original library gates or native actors
        shell: bash
        env:
          LIBRARY_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.fresh_source_revision }}
          CURRENT_WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$LIBRARY_SOURCE" = bd0cf1891083d011b70edab10501c317d3720b78
          [[ "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE" = "$CURRENT_WORKFLOW_SHA"
          test "$(git -C fresh607-code rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE"
          test "$(sha256sum fresh607-code/source-manifest.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = c2c055bfbeb2788fe5097344f97ad296c81af6303c58759a66f559ed64e91031
          python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/run.py --source-preflight
      - name: Checkout exact kernel20 build-only source context for explicit16K
        if: ${{ inputs.page_mode == 'generic16k' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: de1aab259df6bda8ad36f959392e3fc4eb35b622
          path: fresh607-kernel20-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Acquire only exact existing BUILD_ONLY kernel20 input for explicit16K
        if: ${{ inputs.page_mode == 'generic16k' }}
        timeout-minutes: 6
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 300s python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/kernel20_input.py --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-kernel20-source" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/fresh607-kernel20-data"
      - name: Checkout issued Root accepted Six853 DATA record
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: eea3f3022c9214deacc60c92dfca13704420756b
          path: fresh607-record
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Materialize pinned historical input DATA without acquisition or acceptance replay
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/stage_inputs.py --record "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-record" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/fresh607-input-data"
      - name: Checkout the separate expanded604 installer implementation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source }}
          path: expanded604-installer
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require original library source and accepted native604 inputs before native work
        id: installer_policy
        shell: bash
        env:
          IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          WORKFLOW_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(sha256sum expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/ci.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = e9db1d8d2abebe363db9e6ebfc11e7ff2cfb3de19cf053efa7606219058666a3
          test "$(sha256sum expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/source-manifest.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 5f4dbc150a5f8ca6a85843b783e7b5472251a4b0761e75e65f7d82b165a7b629

      - name: Seed the six frozen private cache objects before native work

      - name: Checkout exact retained public input source

      - name: Required FDK pair on this job native base
        id: fdk_pair
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}

        shell: bash
        env:

        run: |

          set -euo pipefail
          source_root=${FDK_SOURCE_ROOT:?}
          native_out=${FDK_NATIVE_OUTPUT:?}
          out=${FDK_OUTPUT:?}
          mkdir -m 700 "$out"
          status=FAIL
          finish() {
              rc=$?
              printf 'FDK_PAIR=%s\nEXIT=%s\n' "$status" "$rc" > "$out/result.txt" || :
              cat "$out/result.txt" || :
              if [[ $status == FAIL ]]; then
                  for log in "$out"/build-*/build.log "$out"/*.log; do
                      [[ ! -f $log ]] || tail -n 40 "$log" || :
                  done
              fi
              return "$rc"

          from pathlib import Path
          import hashlib, json, re, sys
          source, native, out = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])

          bootstrap = json.loads((native / 'bootstrap.json').read_text())
          image = (native / 'image-id').read_text().strip()
          assert re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', image)
          assert bootstrap['status'] == 'image-provisioned' and bootstrap['image_id'] == image
          assert hashlib.sha256((native / 'packages.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == bootstrap['packages_lock_sha256']
          recipe = source / 'packages/libraries/cachy-asahi-fdk-aac/PKGBUILD'
          digest = hashlib.sha256(recipe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          assert digest == '774803633213d77e9879005608ff23528b6780465c7bd00f3234430c9a7346df'
          for name in ('template-inputs.json', 'reviewed-inputs.json'):
              data = json.loads((source / 'scripts/port/fdk-native-stage' / name).read_text())

              (out / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')
          print(image)
          PY
          )
          if [[ -z $image ]]; then
              status=SKIPPED

          python3 -B "$source_root/packages/libraries/cachy-asahi-fdk-aac/materialize.py" \
              --archive "$out/selected-source.tar" --output "$out/recipe" \

          for attempt in 1 2; do

          cat "$out/compare.json"
          status=PASS
          RUN_FDK
          grep -qx 'FDK_PAIR=PASS' "$RUNNER_TEMP/fdk-evidence/result.txt"
